title: Quietly Crunchy German Chinese Long Beans Stew
description: A herbal and crunchy stew featuring Chinese long beans, perfect for a sick day, with a German twist and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: Chinese long beans
ingredients.notes: trimmed and cut into 2 inch pieces

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and celery and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Chinese long beans, bonito flakes, and dried thyme, and stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
